title: Ask AI For a Table, Not a Wall of Text 📊
tags: claude ai tips,ai for beginners,prompt engineering,ai productivity,claude prompts,markdown table,ai comparison,chatgpt tips,ai tips,formatting prompts,claude ai,ai shorts
lines: Ask A-I to compare a few things, and it buries the answer in a wall of text.
Same question. Watch one tiny change make it usable.
Here's the usual mess. Paragraphs you have to read top to bottom.
So I add five words. Turn that into a table.
Same answer, now a grid. Feature down the side, options across the top. Compare a row, pick in seconds.
Comparing anything? End with: as a table. Follow for one A-I trick a day.
